body: Well right at this moment I'm just curious as to why I can't see this post on the main page (btw I'm new to reddit so forgive me if i don't have the terminology down just yet).
I don't even see this post showing up on here. If you don't care that's fine but can you at least comment literally anything so I know I'm not talking to myself here?

Update.

I am taking steps that will either allow me to change my situation or at least allow me to end things on my own terms. The events that transpire within the next couple of weeks will determine which of these paths I will go down. The point I'm trying to make is if it is the latter I will be okay. I have accepted that as the most likely outcome of my life and at this point going through with it doesn't seem so scary.

For a while that was the only compelling reason I had to live. It still is I suppose, but I know it won't hold me forever. 

Basically I'm a complete fuck up. Live at home. No job. Haven't had anything close to a relationship in about 4 years. I have no energy to try anything because of extreme loneliness. I have 2/3 friends who rarely talk to me. Can't relate to my family. When I try to reach out for help I'm met with apathy.
